_comment: Fires every :00 and :30 within active_hours. tone_by_hour sets firmness; overrides replace the message at specific slots. Edit freely, the engine re-reads it each run.

generic.firm: Half-hour check. What are you doing right now? If it isn't a must-do, switch. Pick one open item and put 25 minutes in.
generic.gentle: Quick check-in. Still moving? If you drifted, no guilt, just pick the next thing. If you're heads-down, ignore me and keep going.

overrides.msg: Morning. Here's today's plan. Don't do it all, just pick the first block and start. Which one?
Midday. What have you actually finished? If you're stuck on one thing, switch to the next must-do.
Pause. Stand up, breathe for a minute, water. When you sit back down, switch to a fresh task instead of grinding the same one.
Accountability check. Did today's must-dos move? Yes or no. Close the gap before you eat.
Winding down. Mark what got done, no guilt about what didn't.
